subject: HelixHealth Renewal Kickoff: term amendment & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Lee <susan.lee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixHealth Renewal Kickoff: term amendment & capacity uplift

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our notes, HelixHealth is planning a term amendment to extend through 2028 and add a throughput uplift (expected +2.5x peak tokens) for the predictive triage pipeline. I wanted to kick off a short renewal coordination thread to align stakeholders, confirm timelines, and lock a QBR window so we can present the proposed amendment and the capacity plan.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm internal stakeholder list and legal/procurement contacts (I copied David + Kimberly).
- Redwood to share a draft amendment and MAAP (mutual action and acceptance plan) by Friday 9/11.
- Schedule a 60-minute QBR (Tech + Procurement) for the week of 9/20 — agenda will include capacity sizing, term & pricing, and a migration runway for burst windows.
- Procurement to confirm desired signatory & DocuSign timeline (we can support a two-week signature target).

Open questions for you:
1) Is the 2.5x uplift target accurate for planning? If not, please share expected percentile increases (P50/P95).
2) Any internal blackout windows in late Sep/early Oct that would block exec attendance?

I attached a short MAAP template and an initial amendment PDF stub with the uplift placeholder.

Calendar poll: https://docs.google.com/poll/2A8qQ-calendar-poll-helix (two options: 9/21 10am PT or 9/23 11am PT).

Thanks — happy to triage if you want a quick pre-QBR tech sync before the full meeting.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Renewals
Redwood Inference
attachments: [HelixHealth_MAAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed-amendment-draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Susan Lee <susan.lee@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@helixhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixHealth Renewal Kickoff: term amendment & capacity uplift

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers inline:
- Confirming the uplift: our telemetry team is targeting ~2.2–2.8x peak for the triage pipeline; 2.5x is a reasonable planning midpoint. We can share a short usage export (P50/P95) by EOD Thursday.
- Exec blackout: none in late Sep. 9/21 10am PT works best for our CTO and head of procurement.
- Signatory: Procurement (procurement@helixhealth.com) will route final to Legal — they prefer a two-week signature window but would like the initial draft by 9/11.

Please make sure the QBR agenda includes: detailed burst runway (how we handle backup capacity), rollback/fallback model variants if we see quality regressions, and SLOs for latency during burst.

Tom (cc) will chime in on the technical details later today.

Thanks,
Susan Lee
Director, Data Platforms
HelixHealth

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Susan Lee <susan.lee@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixHealth Renewal Kickoff: term amendment & capacity uplift

Thanks, team. A few internal notes and asks before we finalize the MAAP: 

1) Capacity sizing: Kimberly — can you validate GPU/slot recommendations for a sustained 2.5x peak for the triage workload? Include recommended autoscale headroom for a 3x short burst.
2) Pricing/term: Iren e — I'll draft two term scenarios (36-month extension vs. 24-month + uplift) with modeled unit economics. Want to present both in the QBR so Helix can choose the runway that best matches procurement cycles.
3) Rollout/runbook: Neha — please draft a short runbook for prefix/KV cache warmup and fallback routing (include estimated cold-start penalty and target caching thresholds).

Kimberly: I added the proposed-amendment-draft.pdf to the thread and annotated sections that need legal input (redlines on the data residency and audit log retention bullets). I recommend we propose:
- 24-month base term with an optional 12-month renewal at a fixed uplift rate, or
- 36-month term with a lower per-token uplift and a month-to-month capacity buffer.

Action items for internal owners:
- Kimberly: sizing doc by Fri 9/11 EOD.
- Neha: runbook draft by Fri 9/11 EOD.
- David: pricing scenarios draft by Thu 9/10 noon.

Irene/Susan: we'll include the Google calendar poll options in the QBR invite after Susan confirms 9/21 10am PT.

-David

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Lee <susan.lee@helixhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixHealth Renewal Kickoff: term amendment & capacity uplift

Thanks — short update from ops:

- Preliminary sizing attached (HelixHealth_MAAP_v1.xlsx). For a steady-state 2.5x peak we recommend: 8 dedicated A100-equivalent slots with autoscale headroom to 24 for short bursts (~5–10 minutes). That gives ~3x burst headroom per request-profile assumptions.
- Warmup/runbook notes (high-level): pre-warm KV caches for top-10 prefixes, maintain short-lived prefix cache for live reranking, and prefetch next-token beams for the triage model. Expected cold-start latency hit: additional 120–250ms for first 2–3 requests per session.
- Legal redlines: data residency clause flagged for EMEA customers — noted but not in scope for Helix (US only).

I'll finish a one-pager runbook and upload by EOD Friday. If Helix wants a deeper SRE readout in the QBR we can extend the meeting to 90 minutes.

-Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions & Dedicated Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: [HelixHealth_MAAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
